Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for discharge of specified personnel who abandon their duties during a state of emergency.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to abandonment of duties during a state ofemergency; adding a new section to chapter 41.08 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 41.12 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 41.14RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 43.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Every person holding an office, place, position, or employmentunder the provisions of this chapter, who abandons his or her dutiesduring a state of emergency, as defined in RCW 43.06.210, shall beimmediately discharged. For the purposes of this section, "abandons" means that the personis absent without leave from an assigned shift or work station and theperson has expressed, either by statement or conduct, intent to abstainfrom carrying out his or her duties, despite an ability to exercisesuch duties.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Every person holding an office, place, position, or employmentunder the provisions of this chapter, who abandons his or her dutiesduring a state of emergency, as defined in RCW 43.06.210, shall beimmediately discharged. For the purposes of this section, "abandons" has the same meaningas provided in section 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.14 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Every person holding an office, place, position, or employmentunder the provisions of this chapter, who abandons his or her dutiesduring a state of emergency, as defined in RCW 43.06.210, shall beimmediately discharged. For the purposes of this section, "abandons" has the same meaningas provided in section 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Every Washington state patrol officer who abandons his or herduties during a state of emergency, as defined in RCW 43.06.210, shallbe immediately discharged. For the purposes of this section, "abandons" has the same meaningas provided in section 1 of this act.
